name: AURIX Pro
description: Engineered for the most demanding listeners. The AURIX Pro delivers studio-accurate sound with our proprietary beryllium driver technology.
longDescription:
The AURIX Pro is the culmination of years of acoustic research and precision engineering. Built for studio professionals and audiophiles who refuse to compromise, it features a hand-selected 50mm beryllium driver — a material 7× stiffer than titanium yet lighter than aluminum — producing a frequency response that tracks true from the sub-bass rumble of a kick drum all the way to the air of a cymbal shimmer.

Every element is purpose-built. The memory-foam earcups are wrapped in Japanese protein leather, distributing clamping force uniformly across the head. The single-sided cable entry reduces microphonics during critical listening. And the headband — machined from aerospace-grade 6061 aluminum — provides lasting structural rigidity without adding a gram of unnecessary weight.

features.title: Beryllium Driver
features.desc: Hand-calibrated 50mm beryllium dome, the same material used in high-end studio monitors.

features.title: Memory-Foam Seal
features.desc: Japanese protein leather earcups with 30mm memory foam for 4-hour fatigue-free sessions.

features.title: Detachable Cable
features.desc: Dual 3.5mm + 6.35mm adapter, OFC copper braid, 1.5m tangle-resistant.

features.title: Aerospace Build
features.desc: 6061-T6 aluminum headband and stainless steel yokes. Built to last a decade.

name: AURIX Air
description: Ultra-light construction meets premium sound. AURIX Air is built for marathon listening sessions without fatigue.
longDescription:
Weighing in at just 198g, the AURIX Air redefines what a full-day headphone feels like. Its magnesium alloy frame — used in aerospace components for its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio — feels almost invisible on the head. The 40mm titanium-coated driver delivers a wide, airy soundstage perfectly suited for jazz, classical, and acoustic genres.

The self-adjusting headband eliminates fit fuss entirely. Ultra-soft velour earcups breathe naturally, keeping your ears cool during extended listening. Whether you're working from home, commuting, or simply unwinding, the AURIX Air disappears into your day.

features.title: Titanium Driver
features.desc: 40mm titanium-coated dome for extended highs and a wide, natural soundstage.

features.title: Velour Earcups
features.desc: Breathable micro-velour fabric — runs cool even after hours of wear.

features.title: Magnesium Frame
features.desc: Full magnesium alloy construction. 198g total — 30% lighter than comparable models.

features.title: Auto-Adjust Band
features.desc: Self-adjusting headband fits head sizes 52–64cm with zero manual tuning.

name: AURIX Sport
description: IP54 rated and sweat-proof. AURIX Sport locks in for the hardest workouts while delivering punchy, energetic sound.
longDescription:
The AURIX Sport was designed in the gym, tested on the track, and refined in the studio. Its graphene-composite driver delivers the fast, punchy transient response that makes bass-heavy music hit harder during a workout — without sacrificing mid-range clarity for your podcasts and calls.

IP54 certification means it handles sweat and rain without hesitation. The Sport Grip earcup lining uses a dual-layer silicone mesh that wicks moisture away from the skin. Combined with the secure-fit headband, the AURIX Sport stays locked even during sprints and HIIT sessions.

features.title: Graphene Driver
features.desc: Graphene composite membrane: ultra-light, ultra-rigid. Faster bass response than titanium.

features.title: IP54 Rated
features.desc: Sweat and splash resistant. Train in any conditions.

features.title: Sport Grip Cups
features.desc: Dual-layer silicone mesh earcups wick moisture and grip under movement.

features.title: Secure-Fit Band
features.desc: Tensioned headband with rubber grips — stays put through your hardest sessions.

name: AURIX Studio
description: The ultimate mastering headphone. Flat frequency response and ultra-wide soundstage expose every detail in your mix.
longDescription:
The AURIX Studio is an uncompromising mastering tool. Its 55mm diamond-coated dome driver — the largest in the AURIX lineup — operates with a ruler-flat frequency response from 3Hz to 50kHz. No coloration. No enhancement. Just the truth of your mix, rendered with surgical precision.

At 600Ω impedance, the Studio is engineered to pair with dedicated headphone amplifiers, where it reveals layers of detail that lesser cans simply can't resolve. The dual-entry OFC cable minimizes channel imbalance. The hand-stitched leather headband and lambskin earcups ensure the 320g frame disappears during extended mixing sessions. Limited to 500 units per production run.

features.title: Diamond Dome
features.desc: 55mm CVD diamond-coated driver — stiffest material available, zero resonance coloration.

features.title: Flat Response
features.desc: ±1.5dB from 20Hz–20kHz. Reference-accurate reproduction for mixing and mastering.

features.title: Dual-Entry Cable
features.desc: Balanced dual 3.5mm entry with OFC copper braid eliminates channel crosstalk.

features.title: Lambskin Leather
features.desc: Hand-stitched lambskin headband and earcups. Built and finished by hand.
